title: Feline Philosophy
subtitle: How cats mastered the art of not giving a fluff
bodyHtml:
Hey human.

Whether you love cats or hate cats (rude!), you can learn a thing or two from us.

We live by one rule: we don’t waste our whiskers on what doesn’t matter.
We nap when we want, eat when we’re hungry, and roam where we please.
Nobody’s our boss — humans are just funny-shaped minions that feed us.

Life throws noisy dogs and scary vacuums at us. Do we stress? Nope.
We flick our tails, stretch, and find a warm spot to nap it off.

So maybe try living like a cat:

  • - Let the small stuff slide.
  • - Rest when you need to.
  • - Be picky with your energy.
  • - Find your warm, soft place.

    • You deserve it. Everything else can wait.
